purpose: Build an auditable thinking-and-action system: facts -> evidence grade -> five-dimensional analysis -> 5 Why -> reversal -> options/risk -> smallest action -> result -> review/update.
frozen_business_source: User-owned Earth Online v1/v2 complete manuals; source document bytes remain outside this public repository.
five_why_rule: Each layer is a hypothesis branch; follow the branch with evidence and stop when evidence is insufficient.
reversal_rule: Every important belief must state the strongest countercase, observable disconfirmation and alternative explanation.

high_risk_boundary.rule: Train general reasoning only; never replace doctors, licensed professionals or first-party current official information.
